classifications.rationale: The normative target, S10 rejection/remediation record, isolation and SAST evidence primitives, and existing focused fail-closed adapters did not change in this source-impact range.

The S10 home probe now isolates and restores its fixture environment, checks explicit binds, and cleans up. The SAST campaign now resolves an executable scanner, records build identity and tamper rejection, and writes versioned evidence beside the historical pinned artifact. Other listed tests cover candidate scratch inventory, provider lanes, and later provider/toolchain additions. The real system isolation campaign is unmocked; fail-closed unit tests simulate an unavailable provider only to assert refusal.

These later shared-core and provider changes add candidate requirement traceability, provider-lane evidence, browser/visual and integration-provider execution, provider resource accounting, and push-only delivery configuration. SAST candidate evidence remains required and candidate-bound; security and dependency impact floors remain CRITICAL. src/core/git.ts now excludes only untracked .serena/graphify-out provider scratch from source identity; tracked configuration and legitimate untracked source still contribute, and workspace matching uses the same deterministic digest. The modified status/conformance/ledger documents were inspected as non-normative history and were not used to infer acceptance.

Workflow and toolchain deltas provision real rootless bwrap and pinned provider tools, add packaged-consumer and artifact-bound supply-chain checks, and record evidence in disposable CI worktrees. Existing required workflow jobs remain present; the rootless job has no continue-on-error or skip path.

history.originalRejection: The prior host-home probe tested ${os.homedir()}/Desarrollo. Canonical npm/npx invocation prepended <repo>/node_modules/.bin to PATH; the resulting bwrap bind destination exposed the probed parent, so the probe could PASS with host_repo=visible. Evidence from the direct ./node_modules/.bin/vitest invocation was not reproducible under the canonical invocation.
history.repairRecord: Use a host-only sentinel under a synthetic home outside /tmp, /var/tmp, the workspace bind, and all explicit toolchain binds. Assert the sentinel and SSH directory exist before execution and are masked inside execution. Restore HOME, PATH, and the secret variable and remove sentinel, synthetic home, host marker, and fixture in finally. Correct the repository read-only wording to include the configured-validator workspace exception.
